text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's 1st place...! What a relief... I feel 
like I ran a race that connects our hopes.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Seeing everyone in the stands patting each 
other on the back in pure joy warmed my 
heart to its core.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Looking at the same scenery, sharing what 
we feel. There is no loneliness there, 
only overflowing warmth—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, races really do have a mysterious 
power to them, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I still feel that uplifting sense of unity 
with everyone. I'm sure it's in everyone's 
hearts as well...
choice_data_list: It was born from your running.
This was born from your running.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Is that... so? If it is, that makes me 
very happy.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Becoming someone's hope. That was the 
reason I aimed to race, after all.
choice_data_list:
Let's bring hope to even more people next 
time.
What matters is what comes next.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Eradicating as much loneliness as I 
can— that is my wish!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That is correct. I cannot afford to betray 
those who found hope in me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let us continue to win, so that we may 
become a beacon of hope for everyone.
